content: Typeform URL Parameters (formerly Hidden Fields) let you pass key=value pairs to a form via its URL to pre-fill/personalize and track respondents. For embedded forms use hash (#field=value); Typeform also supports query string (?field=value) for embedded and for standalone/direct share links, with staff guidance to use # for personal/sensitive data and ? for general tracking. Field names must exactly match a hidden field pre-defined in the Typeform builder (Create > Logic/Hidden fields), lowercase with underscores.
